extraction.name: Video-MME
extraction.description: A comprehensive multi-modal evaluation benchmark for assessing MLLMs in video analysis, featuring 900 videos across 6 visual domains with 30 subfields, 2,700 multiple-choice questions, and videos ranging from 11 seconds to 1 hour with integrated subtitles and audio tracks.
extraction.creator: Chaoyou Fu, Yuhan Dai, Yongdong Luo, Lei Li, Shuhuai Ren, Renrui Zhang, Zihan Wang, Chenyu Zhou, Yunhang Shen, Mengdan Zhang, Peixian Chen, Yanwei Li, Shaohui Lin, Sirui Zhao, Ke Li, Tong Xu, Xiawu Zheng, Enhong Chen, Caifeng Shan, Ran He, Xing Sun
extraction.publisher: State Key Laboratory for Novel Software Technology, Nanjing University; State Key Laboratory of Cognitive Intelligence; and collaborating institutions
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Videos were collected from YouTube across 6 key domains (Knowledge, Film & Television, Sports Competition, Life Record, and Multilingual) with 30 finely-grained categories. For each category, videos of varying durations (short <2 minutes, medium 4-15 minutes, long 30-60 minutes) were collected along with subtitles and audio. The dataset consists of 900 videos total (744 with subtitles, all 900 with audio). Question-answer pairs were manually annotated by annotators with strong English proficiency and research experience in vision-language learning, who watched entire videos and created 3 questions each with 4 candidate options, totaling 2,700 QA pairs. A rigorous manual quality review process was conducted where each QA pair was examined by a different annotator, and questions answerable without video content were filtered using Gemini 1.5 Pro.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw videos from YouTube across 6 domains and 30 categories with varying durations (short <2 minutes, medium 4-15 minutes, long 30-60 minutes), along with corresponding meta-information including subtitles (when provided) and audio files. The dataset comprises 900 videos total, with 744 videos having subtitles and all 900 having audio files.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Expert annotators with strong English proficiency and extensive research experience in vision-language learning were recruited. Each annotator thoroughly viewed entire videos and created three questions per video with four candidate options each. Each QA pair underwent examination by a different annotator to verify language clarity, answerability, logical consistency of options, and appropriateness of correct answers. QA pairs answerable without video content were filtered using Gemini 1.5 Pro and returned for revision.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Manual review process verified language clarity, answerability, logical consistency of options, and appropriateness of answers. Text-only filtering using Gemini 1.5 Pro showed less than 15% accuracy, confirming questions require video content. Statistical analysis showed questions encompass 12 distinct task types including perception, reasoning, and information synthesis.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: 3 questions per video, with each question reviewed by a different annotator
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Annotators with strong English proficiency and extensive research experience in vision-language learning
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Gemini 1.5 Pro was used to filter out QA pairs answerable without video content during quality control
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset has limitations related to temporal understanding and long video content. There is a long-tailed distribution of data for complex temporal reasoning in long videos, and availability of such datasets remains limited compared to text and image datasets. For open-source models, restricted input frames can become an information bottleneck for understanding the full content of long videos.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is designed for evaluation of MLLMs and for instruction-tuning focused on temporal reasoning. It emphasizes the need for training supervision for robust temporal understanding in videos.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Videos collected with varying duration lengths including short (<2 minutes), medium (4-15 minutes), and long videos (30-60 minutes) to ensure balanced distribution across temporal contexts. QA pairs that could be answered without video content were filtered out using Gemini 1.5 Pro, with questions not meeting criteria returned for revision.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Videos collected from YouTube across 6 primary domains with 30 fine-grained categories. Meta-information including subtitles and audios obtained. Manual annotation of 2,700 multiple-choice QA pairs (3 per video) by expert annotators with strong English proficiency. Rigorous manual quality review process to verify language clarity, logical consistency, and appropriate correct answers.
